description: Persist a partial patch to the shared Delx Wellness profile. Requires explicit_user_intent: true. Rejects any field containing oauth/token/secret/password/cookie/refresh/api_key/session — the profile is for non-secret wellness context only.

explicit_user_intent.description: Must be true. Pass only after the user explicitly asked to save/update profile data.

patch.description: Partial WellnessProfileDocument patch. Top-level keys: profile, goals, devices, training, nutrition, preferences, safety, notes.
